name: OpenAI Agents SDK
purpose: Primaire agent runtime kandidaat voor OpenAI/Codex tool-making, routing en handoffs.
cost_profile: OpenAI API usage when enabled; no cost during candidate review

name: GitHub MCP Server
purpose: GitHub repositories, issues en pull requests read-first koppelen.
cost_profile: GitHub API quota; no direct spend expected

name: Model Context Protocol servers
purpose: MCP-servercatalogus gebruiken om integraties sneller te kiezen in plaats van custom bouwen.
cost_profile: none during review

name: Playwright MCP
purpose: Browser/research acties voorbereiden via een MCP-server met gestructureerde page snapshots; vooral nuttig voor gecontroleerde browsernavigatie en formulier-previews.
cost_profile: network/quota risk; no direct spend expected during review
rollback_notes: Disable MCP server entry, remove browser profile/cache created for the sandbox, and keep redacted audit evidence.
notes: Primary candidate for browser actions, but keep read-first. Use allowlisted domains and denied-write tests before any runtime enablement.

name: Browser Use
purpose: Python browser-agent framework evalueren voor complexe browserflows waar bestaande browser automation slimmer is dan zelf bouwen.
cost_profile: Hosted Browser Use Cloud/API and model-provider usage can cost money; no cost during candidate review
rollback_notes: Remove test virtualenv/package, disable Browser Use connector, delete sandbox browser profile, revoke Browser Use test key if created, preserve redacted audit evidence.
notes: Strong reuse signal, but cloud stealth/proxy/captcha positioning conflicts with Leon's anti-bypass rule. Only consider for explicit user-approved sandbox flows with those capabilities disabled/forbidden.

name: Firecrawl
purpose: Webresearch versnellen door zoek-, scrape-, crawl- en structured extraction-output naar markdown/JSON te gebruiken in plaats van custom crawlers te bouwen.
cost_profile: Hosted API usage, crawling volume and self-host resources can cost money; no cost during candidate review
rollback_notes: Disable connector, revoke Firecrawl test key if created, clear queued crawl jobs, preserve redacted audit evidence.
notes: Best fit for read-first research extraction if bounded by allowlists, rate limits and cost caps. AGPL repository requires license review before embedding/self-host changes.

name: Firecrawl MCP Server
purpose: Firecrawl search/scrape/extract capabilities via MCP beoordelen, inclusief search-only read profile als veiliger startpunt.
cost_profile: Search-only/keyless modes may be limited; full hosted API usage can cost money; no cost during candidate review
rollback_notes: Disable MCP server entry, revoke Firecrawl test key if created, clear queued crawl jobs, preserve redacted audit evidence.
notes: Prefer evaluating the search-only profile first because it narrows the exposed MCP surface. Full scrape/interact tools require separate permission mapping and sandbox tests.

name: Apify MCP Server
purpose: Apify Actor marketplace en bestaande scrapers/crawlers als MCP-tools beoordelen om niche webdata-workflows niet custom te bouwen.
cost_profile: Actor runs, storage, API usage and agentic payments can cost money; no cost during candidate review
rollback_notes: Disable MCP server entry, revoke Apify test token if created, abort sandbox actor runs if any, preserve redacted audit evidence.
notes: Useful when a proven Actor already solves the task, but default-deny paid actor execution and agentic payments. Only allow discovery/docs first.

name: LiteLLM
purpose: Model routing en provider abstraction evalueren voordat eigen routing groter wordt.
cost_profile: can affect provider usage when enabled; no cost during review

name: Ollama
purpose: Lokale model serving evalueren voor M40/P40 of andere NVIDIA GPU route met eenvoudige CLI/API en modelrouter-integratie.
cost_profile: No direct API cost for local runs, but model downloads, storage, VRAM, power and hosted/cloud options can be significant
rollback_notes: Stop local service, remove approved test models only after review, keep model cache inventory and benchmark logs redacted.
notes: Good first easy-serving candidate. Current Ollama docs say NVIDIA compute capability 5.0+ is supported, with CC 5.0-6.2 requiring newer drivers; still benchmark on actual M40/P40 before routing real work.

name: llama.cpp
purpose: Low-level local inference backend voor GGUF/quantized models, CPU fallback en CUDA offload op oudere of beperkte hardware.
cost_profile: No direct API cost, but model downloads, compile time, disk, RAM, VRAM and power can be significant
rollback_notes: Remove sandbox build dir and approved test model cache only after review; stop local server; keep redacted benchmark logs.
notes: Best fallback/backend candidate for M40/P40 because it can use CPU+GPU hybrid and GGUF quantization. Requires benchmark evidence before routing.

name: vLLM
purpose: High-throughput model serving kandidaat voor moderne NVIDIA GPU's; niet de eerste route voor Tesla M40/P40.
cost_profile: No direct API cost, but install, model downloads, VRAM, power and incompatible hardware debugging can be expensive
rollback_notes: Remove sandbox environment, stop service, remove approved test models only after review, preserve redacted benchmark logs.
notes: Current stable docs require NVIDIA compute capability 7.5+. That excludes Tesla M40 (5.2) and P40 (6.1), so keep only for a later modern GPU path.

name: ExLlamaV2
purpose: Snelle lokale inference kandidaat voor quantized models op moderne consumer NVIDIA GPU's; alleen overwegen als Ollama/llama.cpp onvoldoende zijn.
cost_profile: No direct API cost, but model downloads, CUDA/PyTorch install, VRAM, disk and power can be significant
rollback_notes: Remove sandbox Python environment and approved test model cache only after review; preserve redacted benchmark logs.
notes: Project positions itself for modern consumer GPUs. Hold until actual GPU and baseline Ollama/llama.cpp results show a need.

name: Langfuse
purpose: Observability, traces, evals en kosten meten zonder zelf alles te bouwen.
cost_profile: self-host resources or hosted costs if chosen later

name: Google Workspace MCP
purpose: Planner/mail proof-of-concept versnellen met Gmail, Google Calendar, Tasks en Workspace tools; eerst read/draft/preview, geen live writes.
cost_profile: Google API quota and OAuth setup effort; no direct spend during candidate review
rollback_notes: Disable MCP server, revoke Google OAuth test credentials, reset manifest to candidate/rejected, preserve redacted audit events.
notes: Broad 120+ tool Workspace surface. Strong reuse candidate, but too broad for direct enablement; first sandbox only with read-only mode and denied-write tests.

name: Calendar & Email MCP Server
purpose: Unified calendar/mail/contact read and planning layer across Google, Microsoft, IMAP/SMTP, ICS and JSON calendar sources.
cost_profile: Provider API quotas; no direct spend during candidate review
rollback_notes: Stop server, remove sandbox account config, revoke OAuth/app passwords, downgrade/reject manifest, keep redacted audit logs.
notes: Good fit for a narrow planner PoC, especially read-only ICS/JSON and account aggregation. Smaller adoption signal; write tools and account config require strict sandbox.

name: email-mcp
purpose: Mail-specific MCP candidate for IMAP/SMTP read/search/draft/send workflows when a full Workspace server is too broad.
cost_profile: Mail provider quotas/rate limits; no direct spend during candidate review
rollback_notes: Stop MCP server, remove sandbox mail config, rotate/revoke app password or OAuth token, reset manifest and preserve redacted audit events.
notes: Mail-only and supports read-only mode, but LGPL-3.0-or-later and direct IMAP/SMTP credentials need license/security review before any install.

name: Google MCP catalog
purpose: Official Google MCP catalog/reference to avoid missing current Google-maintained MCP options, including Workspace references.
cost_profile: none during review
rollback_notes: No execution in catalog mode; remove candidate or mark rejected if source becomes irrelevant.
notes: Use as official reference/catalog only. The repo points to a separate Google Workspace extension for Gmail/Calendar.

name: Gemini CLI Workspace extension
purpose: Officially referenced Google Workspace path for Gmail/Calendar/Docs/Sheets/Slides tools; evaluate as an alternative to community Workspace MCP.
cost_profile: Google API quota and OAuth setup effort; no direct spend during candidate review
rollback_notes: Stop MCP server, revoke OAuth test app/token, remove local token storage, reset manifest and preserve redacted audit events.
notes: README explicitly warns that the server can read, modify and delete Workspace data. Treat as high-risk sandbox candidate only.

name: Mem0
purpose: AI agent memory layer later evalueren voor long-term personal memory nadat Leon's lokale review-first memory MVP bewezen veilig is.
cost_profile: Can require model/embedding/provider/vector-store usage; no cost during candidate review
rollback_notes: Disable memory connector, remove sandbox DB/vector data, revoke any test provider keys, preserve redacted audit metadata.
notes: Strong fit for later evaluation. Hold until local MVP has delete/edit/review/confidence policies and a safe benchmark dataset.

name: Graphiti
purpose: Temporal knowledge graph framework later evalueren voor facts die veranderen over tijd, provenance en graph retrieval.
cost_profile: Can require graph/vector storage and model/embedding provider usage; no cost during candidate review
rollback_notes: Disable graph connector, remove sandbox graph/vector data, revoke any test provider keys, preserve redacted audit metadata.
notes: Good later candidate for temporal graph semantics. Not needed for the first SQLite MVP.

name: Cognee
purpose: Open-source AI memory/knowledge graph platform later evalueren voor document/context memory once ingestion and privacy gates exist.
cost_profile: Can require embeddings, databases and provider/API usage; no cost during candidate review
rollback_notes: Disable connector, remove sandbox DB/vector data and ingested documents, revoke any test provider keys, preserve redacted audit metadata.
notes: Promising later for document memory. Hold until Leon has explicit document-ingestion privacy gates.

name: OpenViking
purpose: Context database / virtual filesystem for agent memory, RAG and skills later evalueren als alternatief voor black-box vector memory.
cost_profile: Can require local services, embeddings/VLM/provider setup and storage; no cost during candidate review
rollback_notes: Disable local service, remove sandbox context database/resources, revoke any test provider keys, preserve redacted audit metadata.
notes: Interesting because it exposes context as a virtual filesystem, but AGPL and provider/embedding setup need careful review before any sandbox.

notes: Pin @andrijdavid/vinted-mcp@0.1.2 integrity sha512-Wc4m2I2ci+SGlTzKEnT8Uu9Gzz9EpeUZxpclM5jbRyIGSwUD1UsUNh9sBRMln6OPZnVfJkQJg4BYIzfVIEtJMA==; AGPL-3.0-or-later; stdio, authMode=http, NL domains only.
